summary: Charles & Colvard Ltd filed an 8-K on 6/22/26 disclosing that, while operating under Chapter 11, it held an auction for the sale of substantially all assets. The winning bid of $1,500,000 came from AJS Creations, Inc., topping the stalking horse bid from Jewelry Design Partners LLC (JDP), which had the right to credit bid its DIP facility debt. The sale requires Bankruptcy Court approval, with a hearing scheduled for June 22, 2026. A former board member, Duc Pham, is a manager of the stalking horse bidder. Watch for court confirmation and any rival bids or objections before closing.
